content: Home visits are available for patients who are physically unable to travel to the clinic due to age, disability, or post-surgical recovery, and must be pre-approved by the clinic's medical director on a case-by-case basis. Eligible patients may request a home visit by contacting the front desk at least 48 hours in advance; same-day home visits are not guaranteed and depend on doctor availability and geographical proximity. Home visits currently cover General Practice and Pediatrics consultations only; specialty home visits for Cardiology, Orthopedics, or Dermatology are not available due to equipment requirements. An additional home-visit surcharge of INR 500 is applied to cover travel costs; this is separate from the standard consultation fee and is not covered by most insurance plans. Patients receiving home visits must ensure that a responsible adult is present at the address throughout the consultation.
